extraction.Name: Rose LaPoint
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded September 22, 1925, by the Commercial State Bank of Gregory
extraction.Buyer: Rose LaPoint Good Eagle and Alfred Good Eagle conveyed the Southeast quarter of Southwest quarter of Section 17 to Orra B. Shaffer for $800; on February 5, 1926, same parties conveyed the Northeast quarter of Southwest quarter of Section 17 to Orra B. Shaffer for $800; on June 21, 1926, the Northwest quarter of Southwest quarter of Section 17 was conveyed to the same man for $1050; on November 23, 1926, the remainder of the land was conveyed to Shaffer for $1000
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739686 issued; Southwest quarter section 17, township 100, range 73; receipt for patent signed by allottee April 3, 1920; allottee appears to have married and taken the name Rose LaPoint Good Eagle; husband Alfred Good Eagle joined in conveyances
